id.description: Client-provided request identifier copied into the response.

path.description: Knowledge base root path. Defaults to the current working directory when omitted. Empty paths, paths over 4096 characters, and paths containing NUL, newline, or carriage return are rejected by the reference JSONL server before dispatch.

dry_run.description: When true, write methods return planned work without mutating the knowledge base.

approved.description: When true, the caller confirms a non-dry-run write has been approved by a user or trusted local policy.
